column3: The Fimm Himnar─the five firmaments... 'Tis sobering to think they are all mankind has left.
There are no other vessels in the sky, much less realmships. It must be rare indeed to encounter those from another collective.
Player─do you see the object in the distance? That is apparently the realmship of water, *Naglfar*.
In order to evade the jötnar, it is perpetually on the move. That is why the journey takes so long.
Not only must the crew of *Glaðr* be alert for thralls, they must also anticipate the mother ship's ever-changing course. Simply returning home is a trying task.
At long last, we're close enough to *Naglfar* to make out the details. I cannot help but wonder what sights await us there...
With our comrades duly reassured, we may direct all our attention to the task ahead. Let us be ready when the time comes to disembark!
